## Outcome

Describe the user-visible result and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run test:host`
- [ ] `npm run smoke`

- [ ] English and Chinese documentation kept aligned

## Privacy and security

- [ ] No credentials, private screenshots, account data, paths, settings files, raw quota responses, or long diagnostics are included.
- [ ] New network, startup, persistence, or data fields are documented in both privacy files.
